name: wilttrade
caption:
TRADE COURT, CASE #4: WE TRADED WILT 🎮🏀 He scored 100 in a game for us. Less than three years later, he was gone.

• 1961-62: Wilt averaged 50.4 PPG and scored 100 in one game
• 1965 All-Star break: we traded him to Philadelphia for Paul Neumann, Connie Dierking and Lee Shaffer
• 1967: Wilt won the title with the 76ers
• It's still cited as a star traded for far less than he was worth

facts.claim: In 1961-62 Wilt Chamberlain averaged 50.4 points per game and scored 100 points in one game for the Warriors. At the 1965 All-Star Weekend he was traded to the Philadelphia 76ers. In the 1966-67 season he won the NBA championship with the 76ers (1967 champion).

In 1965 Paul Neumann was traded at mid-season with Connie Dierking and Lee Shaffer (1 trade) to the San Francisco Warriors for Wilt Chamberlain, a trade frequently cited as an example of a star player being traded for far less than he is worth.
